concepts.title: Whispering Wood
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished high-end fantasy action game MAIN MENU concept in a wide landscape 16:9 frame, pristine AAA presentation. Game title exactly "PROPHECY". English menu options exactly "Continue", "New Game", "Load Game", "Settings", "Quit", each shown once; Continue selected. These are main-menu choices, NOT a pause menu. No PAUSED, Resume, inventory, weapon icons, or French text. Two input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first is our approved pause menu with elegant high-contrast serif typography and luminous selection; second is our celestial weapon wheel with exquisite white engraving, stars and restrained violet glow. Do not copy their forest composition or layout. Translate their care and refinement into the specific new direction below, with a wholly fresh backdrop and composition. Typography must be sharp and readable, graceful yet robust fine strokes, professional hierarchy and spacing; no generic web cards, dashboard, game-store tiles or busy filler text. Subtle local shading for contrast where useful. Real detail and material/light depth, smooth antialiasing, not muddy or cheap. Number and concept name in a very small unobtrusive top corner, not a dominant heading. Single complete menu screen, not a collage or contact sheet.
Specific direction: Classic cinematic forest at first dawn, dew and pale flower beds, a distant narrow path. Quiet menu entirely in the LEFT quarter; the word PROPHECY huge but airy above it; violet fine underline ending in a tiny four-point star under Continue. No visible boxes. The RIGHT three quarters are open immersive landscape. Natural emerald green, silver mist, subtle charcoal fade only at left. A deliberate refined baseline with incredible typography.
